adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, createAllCalendarEvents was changed to iterate `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` and, when a matching credential isn’t found in `this.calendarCredentials`, it does an `await prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: destination.credentialId }, ... })` inside that loop. This creates an N+1-shaped pattern and, as written, the awaits occur serially per destination calendar, adding multiple DB round-trips to the event-creation path. This is a performance/scalability concern rather than a correctness defect, and batching via `findMany({ where: { id: { in: [...] }}})` (or prefetching) would avoid the sequential per-item fetch.
